why: Five different caption and band numbers were in use (Claude Design 0/240; Antigravity prod-v6 stage y=0..908 with cy=960; seed pack scene-and-cognitive-video-qa band 932..1080 with cy=1006; the design-ideas note's 840 stage; the master prompt v6). This file is the one source. Every renderer and checker reads these numbers instead of keeping its own.

hairline.progress: width = 1920 * t / duration, updated every frame
hairline.rule: The only thing above the stage. No title bar, no labels.

stage.rule: Real footage or the designed title and end cards only. Nothing from the band may enter it.

band.ambient_option: Variant only: the stage's bottom 156 px blurred 60 px at 18% luminance under the pill. Solid fill is the default.

caption_pill.render: Burned into eranos-{cut}.mp4. A caption-free master ships as eranos-{cut}-clean.mp4.

font.features: kern, liga; curly quotes; real ellipsis

breaking: Prefer one line when the text fits.
Two lines: break at the strongest clause boundary (after . ; : , or before and/but/so/or/because/which/that), then choose the break that makes the two lines most equal in width.
Never leave one long line and an orphan word; the shorter line is at least 60% of the longer.
Never end a line on an article, preposition or conjunction ('a', 'the', 'of', 'to', 'and'...).
Never split a protected name or number: 'Muse Glimmer', 'Muse Spark', 'Muse Code', 'Llama 3.2', 'claim · do · report', '12 to 51 percent'.

timing.bridge_rule: If the gap to the next cue is 0.5 s or less (this covers the 0.14 s minimum in the master prompt), the pill stays on: the old text fades out over 3 frames and the new text fades in over 4; the pill resizes over 6 frames. The pill never blinks.
timing.reading_budget: 0.5 + words/3.0 seconds <= time the cue is fully visible (lead, linger and bridging included).
timing.linger_rule: Out-time is speech end + 6 frames, extended up to 1.5 s when the reading budget needs it, never into the next cue's lead. The narration leaves that pause after fast lines.

web_player.captions_on: <source> = eranos-{cut}.mp4 (burned-in); <track kind=captions default> stays in the DOM with track.mode = 'hidden'
web_player.swap: Keep currentTime and play/pause state when swapping files.

footage.browser: Real Google Chrome, light theme, clean profile, bookmarks bar hidden, no extensions, native classic scrollbar visible
footage.chrome: The browser's own tab strip and address bar stay visible; nothing drawn on top. The real URL and title are what the viewer reads.
footage.placement: Full bleed at (0, 4). No drawn frame, shadow, rounding, scaling or grading.
footage.scrollbar: Visible on the right edge. Pages style it in brand colors (thumb #8A8476 on #EDE8DC track, 12 px).
footage.page_design_rule: Anything the film holds on must fit 1280 x 540 CSS px. On /requests/:id each band is at most 460 CSS px tall.

pacing.reading_budget: every on-screen text group: 0.5 + words/3.0 <= seconds it is fully visible
pacing.callout_rule: Prefer the page's own status banners. A film callout, if any, echoes the spoken keywords and has at most 8 words.
pacing.clearance_rule: At least 24 px between any callout, badge or pointer element and any window, card, frame or band edge.
pacing.pointer: Visible, 600-900 px/s, eased, 150-250 ms dwell before a click, the page's own hover and press states only.

guide_figure_option.rule: Stays in the band, left of the pill, >= 24 px from it; the pill stays centered at x 960. Laser dot aims at the edge of a real element the caption names.
guide_figure_option.status: option, owner idea; at most 6 points in the 3:00 cut and 2 in the 0:60
